use-click-any-where: Runs something whenever a click happens anywhere on the page.
use-click-away: Runs something when a click lands outside a set of elements.
use-clipboard: Copies to the clipboard with a copied flag that resets automatically.
use-controllable-value: A single value that can be controlled from outside or manage itself.
use-counter: A counter with named actions that state the intent.
use-debounce: A copy of a value that lags behind it by a short delay.
use-debounce-fn: Delays a function until calls to it pause for a moment.
use-document-visibility: Tracks whether the browser tab is currently visible.
use-element-size: Tracks the size of an element using ResizeObserver.
use-event-listener: Adds an event listener that is removed automatically along with its scope.
use-fps: Tracks how many frames per second the browser is rendering.
use-fullscreen: Controls fullscreen mode, with all vendor prefixes still required.
use-hash: The # part of the page URL, readable and writable.
use-hover: Tracks whether the pointer is over an element.
use-in-viewport: Tracks whether an element is currently visible on screen.
use-interval: Runs something repeatedly, with an interval that may change.
use-is-hydrated: Tracks whether the page has been hydrated in the browser.
use-is-match-media: Tracks whether a media query currently matches.
use-is-online: Tracks whether the browser considers itself online.
use-lock-fn: Wraps an async function so it cannot run twice at the same time.
use-mouse: Tracks the pointer position, with touch support.
use-network: Tracks network status in as much detail as the browser exposes.
use-os: Detects the current operating system from the navigator.
use-previous: Tracks the previous value of something that changes.
use-reset-state: State that can be reset back to its initial value.
use-scroll-lock: Locks page scrolling for dialogs, drawers, and fullscreen menus.
use-stick-to-bottom: Keeps a scroll container pinned to the bottom as its content grows.
use-text-selection: Tracks the currently selected text and its position on screen.
use-throttle: A copy of a value that updates at most once per interval.
use-throttle-fn: Limits a function to run at most once per interval.
use-timeout: Runs something once after a delay.
use-title: The page title, readable and writable.
use-toggle: Toggles a value back and forth between two options.
use-why-did-you-update: Logs which props changed each time the component re-renders.
verification-01: An email verification page with a resend button.
visually-hidden: Hides content visually while keeping it available to screen readers.
visually-hidden-input: A hidden input that stays readable by assistive technology and is still submitted with forms.
